info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Subscription Management API
info.description: The Subscription Management API facilitates the removal of subscriptions linked to specific customers. By allowing clients to delete a subscription using the provided customer and subscription identifiers, this API serves businesses looking to streamline their subscription management processes. Typical consumers include account administrators and billing departments who need to efficiently manage customer subscriptions. This endpoint helps ensure that businesses maintain accurate subscription records and assist customers with their account preferences.

delete.summary: Delete a specific subscription for a customer.
delete.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a particular subscription associated with a specified customer. Ensure that the subscription ID is correct before proceeding, as this action cannot be undone.

requestBody.description: Request body for deleting a specific subscription associated with a customer. The request requires the appropriate identifiers to correctly target the intended subscription for deletion.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content.
